QuestInfo.1: Consult with #b#m400000000##k's captain knight, #b#p3000000##k, and transport the Blue Dragon Cannon.

0.0: The soldiers are in much better spirits, thanks to you. Sorry for reducing you down to grunt work, but we all have to get our hands dirty sometimes. \r\n#L0##bThat's all right. Carrying all that stuff around was good for my muscles.#l\n#k
0.1: Hahaha! Nothing like a good workout to get you back into fighting shape! Now, tell me. You ever heard of the #bBlue Dragon Cannon#k?\r\n#L0##bUh, isn't that a really ancient weapon?#l\n#k
0.2: You're darn right it is, but the thing packs a wallop. Now, it's been a couple millennia since the last time it was fired, but we're going to be the ones to bring it back. The reconstruction's almost complete.\r\n#L0##bReconstruction?#l\n#k
0.3: Well, yeah. It's old! #b#p3000000##k can fill you in on the details and get you out to the cannon. I want you to go help them out.\r\n#r#e(If you accept, you will automatically move to the relevant field.)\r\n

yes.0: #b#p3000000##k's ready for you over in #b#m400000000##k. Can't wait to see what the Blue Dragon Cannon can do.

no.0: This task is of the utmost importance!

1.0: #b#p3001001##k told me you were coming my way. It's been a while since you were in #b#m400000000##k, hasn't it?
